coordinateSystem: Top-left origin; integer hull C logical pixels; nearest-neighbour display; paths relative to this manifest

reference.supersedes: ../assets-2/manifest.json sails.main-sail only; historical manifest describes the original short sail

palette.source: All 48 opaque RGB values from deck.png
palette.scope: main-sail.png, rest.png, billow.png, hull-c-frame-0.png, hull-c-frame-1.png, mast-occluder.png. Generated sources are unnormalized provenance, not runtime textures.

sail.description: Generated unfurled cream sail and horizontal wooden yard. Same 114-pixel span and center attachment as the short sail. Taller canvas reaches just above the original deck clearance.

animation.attachmentMotion: Inherit ship bob. Keep yard pivot attached to the new mast; no independent sail translation. If mast sway is added later, transform the attached yard with it.
animation.description: Subtle lower panel/shadow shift and roughly 2-3px center hem lift; identical generated yard and fixed corner strips.

overlays.description: Alternative expanded full-hull-coordinate overlays; draw instead of the strip, never both. Their height/origin differ from old 426x161 overlays to preserve negative-y sail pixels.

integration.requiredAssetDependency: Tall mast from fm/deck-mast-art; not duplicated in this branch
drawOrder: Hull with old baked upper mast/nest/rigging removed
Depth-sorted crew and unchanged lower mast occluder at hull [202,48], baseline 110
integration.bounds: Allow negative hull y; sail top is -15, mast tip is -110.
integration.warning: extras.json still describes the old 114x27 short-sail frames. Apply this manifest's frameSize and position when integrating the tall mast; this assets-only branch alone is not a runtime-ready merge.

normalization.implementation: C# System.Drawing; mechanical cleanup of image-generator artwork, no procedural drawing
normalization.method: Each destination pixel samples a floor-bounded source block. Retain if at least half the block has alpha >=128; median opaque RGB per channel; nearest squared-RGB distance to exact deck palette; binary alpha; no dithering.
normalization.registration: Both sources use frame 0's crop, preserving the generated hem movement. Frame 1 copies frame 0 rows 0..7 and x0..11/x102..113 below them to fix yard and corner ties. Original lower mast occluder remains unchanged.
normalization.scale: One output pixel equals one hull pixel; 32px standing crew. Never smooth when enlarging.

review.description: Static fitting studies only. Old upper rig cleared for comparison, no new long ropes. Same 32px crew and tall mast in every column.

limitations: Two-frame stylized cloth breathing, not a physically authored sail simulation.
Median palette normalization leaves some uneven seam/wood clusters at large zoom, consistent with shipped generated assets.
Tall mast, rope fitting and the frame-size/position metadata must be integrated together; no application install, reload or runtime validation was performed.
